errors.text_span: Die y-Achse ist mit Prozent beschriftet
errors.evidence: The y-axis is not just labeled with 'percent', but with the full description '% der Erwerbsbevölkerung (20 bis 64 Jahre)' (percentage of the working population (20 to 64 years)). Omitting the subject of the percentage is a significant error.
The blue line representing Germany starts at approximately 3.6% in the year 2000, not 3.4%. The line is visibly above the 3.5% mark on the chart.
The green line representing Austria starts at approximately 6.7% or 6.8% in the year 2000, which is noticeably higher than the stated 6.6%.
